decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop uses existing sheltered-workshop infrastructure and know-how, so the option is cheap to hold while its custom-furniture demand is still being revealed.
Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the core psychiatric business and is reimbursable, so its uncertain uptake still justifies waiting rather than abandoning it.
Senior living counseling costs little, serves growing demographic demand and was prominently featured, so its value appears to be materializing.
The retail shop carries fixed running costs and low visibility, but it supports workshop sales and inclusion goals, so the option stays open for another period before a firmer judgment.
Senior meal delivery was launched only in 2024 and fits the eldercare core with low incremental cost, so its uncertainty is still too high to justify abandonment.
